description: Discover the URLs of one site - sitemap first, then same-host links from the homepage. When to use: you need the list of pages a site exposes before fetching a few of them. Do not use: as a crawler (max 50 URLs, no page content) or to bypass robots.txt. Returns: {url, final_url, count, urls:[{url,source}], cached, took_ms, _metering}. Metered: shares the web free bucket (50 calls/day per IP together with web_fetch), then 1 credit per call over x402 - there is no API key; the 402 answer carries accepts[].

url.description: Site root or page URL (max 2048 chars).

name: web_map
title: Web Map
